name: The Studio by Hill Street
accessibilityNotes: Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible parking lot.
reviewNotes:
Studio is inside the Hill Street Boxing facility. Website FAQ also shows (631) 377-7087 and Google Maps shows (631) 443-1032; only the header number from the website is recorded.

Directory research 2026-10-04: No Facebook page found (the site links only Instagram). No opening hours are published. The site also shows (631) 377-7087 in one spot and Google lists (631) 443-1032; the header/contact number (631) 377-3087 is used. press@thestudiobyhillstreet.com is also listed for press. Description added because current had none.
description: An adult ballroom and Latin dance studio on Hill Street in Southampton village. It teaches group classes, private lessons and wedding first-dance lessons in styles such as salsa, bachata, cha-cha, waltz, foxtrot and tango.
